collection.description: Only one Fourpetal Ball Cactus is in flower: a dye maker wants its petals, a naturalist its insect visitors.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: Only one Fourpetal Ball Cactus is flowering this week. A dye maker wants its petals; a naturalist hopes to learn which insects visit it.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The dye is too faint for a full garment, but inspires a delicate ink.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The dye maker gets a stronger color, but the plant may set no seed this season; future scarcity becomes a concern.

text_only.what: the plant may set no seed
text_only.reason: a wild plant; no food or crop is lost

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The alternative works imperfectly, prompting a new palette rather than the original color.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: A record of pollinators and scent emerges; no petals are harvested.
